## Plan

### Mechanics summary `[COMMUNITY]` (whisperofthehouse.com, updated 2026-11-16)
- 512 HP (535 at A8+). Starts with 3 Artifact and Withering Presence.
- **Withering Presence:** one Wither card goes into your hand for every 6 cards you play. Withers are unplayable and deal damage at end of turn (3 base, more when upgraded).
- **Cycle:**
  1. Ebb: 22 + 33 block
  2. Eye Lasers: 11×2
  3. Increasing Intensity: adds and upgrades Withers, gains Strength; no attack
- **A second source disagrees** (sts2-calculator.pages.dev boss guide, accessed 2026-11-19; latest patch listed on the site: V110): Ebb applies Ebb 3 (−3 Strength and Dexterity for your turn) with no damage; Eye Lasers 11×2 (12×2); Increasing Intensity gains 33 Block and 3 Strength (4), growing; a Wither comes with every **4th** non-Status card played, has Retain and Exhaust, and deals **2** at end of turn if held. The v0.111.1 patch notes give Ebb damage (22, 26 at higher ascension), which matches the first source, so that one is kept; the Wither numbers stay open (gap 29). `tools/plan_turn.py` counts 3 per held Wither and follows the game's playable flag for it.

### Deck checklist
- **Countable checks** (`tools/deck_check.py`, tuned on the history 2026-11-19) `[PLAYER-DATA, weak]`: Strength cards at least 1 (fewer, bigger hits against Wither; survived 0.8, fatal 0.3); multi-hit attacks at least 1 (damage per card played; survived 1.7, fatal 0.8).
- **Fewer, bigger cards per turn.** Every sixth card played summons a Wither. Strength, multi-hit and X-cost attacks beat many small cards.
- **Exhaust outlets for Withers.** Exhausted beats discarded, since discarded Withers come back.
- **Strip its 3 Artifact** before relying on Vulnerable or Weak.
- **Block 22 on Ebb and 22 on Eye Lasers.**
- **Damage on Increasing Intensity turns**, the free window.

### HP target on arrival
- Ironclad benchmark: median 48, p75 70, p90 74 (the widest spread of any boss). **Rest if HP is below about 58.** Survived fights started at 87% median, fatal ones at 65% (all characters).

### First three turns
1. Ebb (22 + 33 block): block; don't waste big attacks into its block.
2. Eye Lasers (11×2): block, or use cheap Artifact strippers.
3. Increasing Intensity: maximum damage.

### Potion plan
- Debuff potions only after the Artifact is gone. Damage potions on Increasing Intensity turns.

### What killed the Player here, and the counter
- Ironclad: 0 of 5 fatal (all characters: 10 of 28 fatal, the most for any Act 3 boss). `[PLAYER-DATA]`
- Counter: arrive healthy, play efficient big turns, exhaust Withers.
